data.title: Hims & Hers Health facing penalties from Visa for credit card disputes - report
data.description:
• Visa (V) will assess penalties on Hims & Hers Health (HIMS) close to $75,000 in September after receiving thousands of complaints related to credit card disputes.
  • The telehealth provider was put into Visa's Acquirer Monitoring Program following a rise in disputes in July, Bloomberg reported. Each dispute carries an $8 penalty.
  • The complaints apparently have to do with weight-loss drug subscriptions.
  • Hims & Hers didn't find out it was placed into the program until earlier in August when payment processor Stripe (STRIP) notified it, the news service added.
  • To exit Visa's program, Hims & Hers must cut its dispute rate to below 1.5% of transactions for three months. 
  • "We take our responsibility to be transparent with our nearly 3 million customers extremely seriously," a Hims & Hers spokesperson told Bloomberg. "That is why we've built a checkout process that is clear about the cost of a Hims & Hers membership and any medication a provider chooses to prescribe."

data.title: SolarMax Technology receives Nasdaq notice
data.description:
• SolarMax Technology (SMXT) said on Friday it received a Nasdaq notice on Aug. 20 for failing to file its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
  • The company must submit a compliance plan to Nasdaq by October 19.
  • Upon acceptance, Nasdaq may grant the company an additional 180 days to address the filing deficiency, extending the deadline to February 16, 2027.
  • Share -4.58%

data.title: Silver Storm announces $7.5M non-brokered private placement with Eric Sprott
data.description:
Silver Storm Mining (SVRS:CA) announced on Friday a non-brokered private placement of 15M units of the company at $0.50 per unit for gross proceeds of $7.5M. 

The company highlighted that Eric Sprott, through 2176423 Ontario, a corporation beneficially owned by him and a current significant shareholder of the company, is subscribing to the entire offering.

Each unit will consist of one common share of the company and one-half of one common share purchase warrant. Each whole warrant will entitle the holder to acquire one additional common share at a price of $0.70 for a period of 18 months from the closing of the offering.

No commissions or finders' fees are payable by the Company in connection with the Offering.

The company intends to use the net proceeds of the offering to fund surface and underground drilling programs at its La Parrilla Silver Mine Complex and for general corporate and working capital purposes.

The offering is expected to close on or about August 25, 2026. 

Source: press release

data.title: Anthropic hires former Google chip developer as it pursues in-house solution: report
data.description:
Anthropic (ANTHRO) hired Amir Salek, former head of Google's (GOOG)(GOOGL) tensor processing unit team, according to Bloomberg.

Salek served as the founder and head of Google's TPU program from 2013 through 2022 and helped deliver the first seven generations of TPUs to Google's data centers. Before that, he worked at Nvidia (NVDA) for eight years, where he founded and scaled the company's system-on-a-chip organization. Since leaving Google, he has served as the senior managing director at Cerberus Capital Management, a private equity company.

Salek will report to Anthropic's head of compute, James Bradbury, according to the report. 

Anthropic has sourced its chips from Nvidia, Google and Amazon (AMZN). An in-house version would help it diversify its chips supply even further.

Anthropic's chief rival, OpenAI (OPENAI), recently revealed its in-house chip, Jalapeño, which was designed specifically to run inference for large language models. It partnered with Broadcom (AVGO) and Celestica (CLS) on the project.

data.title: Columbus Circle Capital says Elroy Air wins up to $46M U.S. Army contract
data.description:
• Columbus Circle Capital (CMII) said Elroy Air was awarded a $46.1M firm-fixed-price U.S. Army contract to develop an autonomous hybrid-electric VTOL uncrewed aircraft system for modular multi-mission payload delivery.
  • The contract, awarded through Army Contracting Command, has an estimated completion date in 2029. About $5.1M in fiscal 2026 funds were obligated at the time of the award.
  • Elroy Air’s Chaparral drone is designed for autonomous heavy-cargo delivery, and the contract builds on prior Army agreements, the company said.

data.title: Two Harbors gets final regulatory approval for CrossCountry deal
data.description:
Two Harbors Investment (TWO) announced it received the final regulatory approval for its planned sale to CrossCountry Mortgage.

The deal is expected to close before the market opens on Tuesday, according to a statement on Friday.

TWO stockholders will be entitled to receive $12.00 per share in cash. In addition, TWO stockholders of record at the close of business on Aug. 24 will be entitled to receive a stub period dividend in an amount equal to $0.20326 per share of TWO common stock. The stub period dividend will be paid with the merger consideration and will not reduce or otherwise affect the merger consideration.

data.title: Applied Optoelectronics slips as it files for $600M equity distribution deal
data.description:
• Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) shares slipped more than 4% in extended trading on Friday as the optical component company filed for a $600M equity distribution deal.
  • The agreement was entered into with investment firms Raymond James and Needham, Applied said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

data.title: BIGG rebrands as Surge Digital, announces 7-for-1 share consolidation
data.description:
• BIGG Digital Assets (BIG:CA) plans to change its name to Surge Digital and its TSXV ticker from BIGG to SRGE.
  • The name, ticker and share-consolidation changes are expected to take effect on August 26, 2026.
  • The company will consolidate its common shares at a 7-for-1 ratio.
  • BIGG currently has 355.78M shares outstanding, which will fall to ~50.83M after consolidation.
  • Surge Digital will continue to own and operate Netcoins, Blockchain Intelligence Group and TerraZero.
